purpose: Read-only metadata projection of the 902 CUDA F.dropout (fused_dropout) events of the original deterministic RF2 run. It checks the CUDA-compatible dropout counter model on the real product stream: same shapes, same order, same Philox offsets. No mask array, no npz payload and no neural output is copied. Diagnostic oracle only: product code never imports it and it is never used as model input.

source.scope: independent random-mask metadata, neural outputs never supplied
source.note: The listed recording path is relative to the migration example root and is read-only host content; it is not part of the migrated tree.

generation_environment.script: test/rf2/scripts/ab_prediction.sh (unchanged original RF2 case, fixed inputs, seed 42)

copied_files.description: projection of the 902 functional_dropout events (shape, stride, dtype, p, offset_before, offset_after, location, inplace, contiguous, pointer alignment, observer validity flags, device), the CUDA-vs-CPU stream split and the seed-0 / offset-0 origin
copied_files.projection_validation: every recorded offset pair was re-derived from (numel, launch profile) while projecting; any mismatch aborted the projection

contract_recorded_by_the_asset.cpu_stream_note: the 2288 cpu torch.bernoulli events belong to the custom CPU dropout head that this work does not touch; they are summarised, not replayed

usage_restriction: Expected offsets only. The test replays the recorded (shape, dtype, p) sequence through the candidate counter model and compares the offset pairs; it never derives an expectation from the candidate and nothing in src/ reads these files.
